CWE-22.title: Path Traversal
CWE-22.summary: The code may allow user-controlled paths to access files outside the intended directory.
CWE-22.recommendation: Normalize and validate paths against an allowed base directory before file access.

CWE-78.title: OS Command Injection
CWE-78.summary: The code may execute operating system commands built from untrusted input.
CWE-78.recommendation: Avoid shell execution, pass arguments as arrays, and validate allowed commands and arguments.

CWE-89.title: SQL Injection
CWE-89.summary: The code may build SQL queries using untrusted input.
CWE-89.recommendation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements instead of string concatenation.

CWE-190.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
CWE-190.summary: The code may perform arithmetic that overflows the valid integer range.
CWE-190.recommendation: Check integer bounds before arithmetic and use wider or checked arithmetic where appropriate.

CWE-259.title: Use of Hard-coded Password
CWE-259.summary: The code contains a password or credential embedded directly in source.
CWE-259.recommendation: Move secrets to a secure secret manager or environment-specific configuration.

CWE-321.title: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key
CWE-321.summary: The code contains a cryptographic key embedded directly in source.
CWE-321.recommendation: Store cryptographic keys in a secure key manager and rotate exposed keys.

CWE-327.title: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
CWE-327.summary: The code may use weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithms.
CWE-327.recommendation: Use modern approved algorithms such as AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 where appropriate.

CWE-328.title: Use of Weak Hash
CWE-328.summary: The code may use weak or collision-prone hashing algorithms.
CWE-328.recommendation: Use stronger hash functions such as SHA-256 or dedicated password hashing functions when storing passwords.

CWE-416.title: Use After Free
CWE-416.summary: The code may use memory after it has been freed.
CWE-416.recommendation: Do not access freed memory, clear pointers after free, and ensure ownership is well defined.

CWE-787.title: Out-of-bounds Write
CWE-787.summary: The code may write outside the bounds of allocated memory.
CWE-787.recommendation: Validate bounds before writing and use size-aware APIs.
